title: Ordinary and cochain tensor reduction from tensor models alone
statement: Let C,J,B,tau be as in [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] and let A be tensor-only normalized model data [def-coef-semilinear-tensor-reduction-models]. Transpose the actual ordinary horizontal transition through the ordinary scalar adjunction to define ordinaryReduction. Its degreewise components form cochainReduction. For any indices n<=m and arbitrary unbounded system complexes P,Q, scalar tensor chain comparison followed by scalar extension of evaluation tensor comparison and cochainReduction of their total tensor equals the total tensor of the two cochainReductions followed by evaluation tensor comparison at n. No internal-Hom data, flatness or cartesianness is assumed. The precise equation is lean.statement.

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p.21 (singleton extension and below-level scalar extension); Proposition 4.17(a), printed pp.25-26 (tensor projection). Stacks Tags 03EK, 06YY, 07A4, 06YT and 0FND supply the module tensor and normalized derived-adjunction constructions.

proof.text: Transpose the ordinary equation through the scalar adjunction. Precompose with inverse evaluation tensor comparison. Sheafification and pure tensors detect equality. The ordinary scalar unit sends x to its extension section; ordinary evaluation tensor and scalar tensor comparison have the specified pure-section formulas. Horizontal restriction of a pure tensor is the tensor of its two restrictions, so the two transposes agree.

Naturality of the ordinary transpose proves that its degreewise components commute with differentials. This is the induced cochain-adjunction transpose. Precompose the asserted total-tensor identity with every degree summand. The two comparison-model summand equations and the preceding ordinary identity identify these maps. Total summand extensionality gives equality of the cochain maps.

lean.statement:
theorem cochain_tensor_reduction
    (A : SystemTensorReductionModels.{c, v, r} J B τ) {m n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (Systems.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ) ℤ) :
    (A.scalarTensorModel h).chain
        (((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
      ((A.scalar h).model.E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((A.tensorEvaluationModel m).chain P Q) ≫
      cochainReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h
        ((totalTensor.{c, v, r} (coefficientSequenceTopology J)
          (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ)).obj (P, Q)) =
    (totalTensor.{c, v, r} J (B n)).map
        (Prod.mkHom (cochainReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h P)
          (cochainReduction.{c, v, r} J B τ A h Q)) ≫
      (A.tensorEvaluationModel n).chain P Q
